purpose: Specify verifiable qualification gates for a human-centered, accessible holiday-planning experience. Values in this contract are proposed targets, not measured performance.

excluded_authorities: objective measurement of happiness or wellbeing

principles.name: intent_first
principles.requirement: Users can begin with a chosen purpose for the trip, skip questions, and revise preferences without completing a mandatory long quiz.

principles.name: truthful_unknowns
principles.requirement: Unknown price, inventory, access, schedule, weather or transfer information is labelled as unknown; missing data never imply a positive claim.

principles.name: agency_without_dark_patterns
principles.requirement: Every recommendation can be edited or dismissed. There are no automatic bookings, silent confirmed-plan edits, forced upsells or fake urgency.

principles.name: accessible_whole_journey
principles.requirement: Digital accessibility and evidence about the physical access chain are reported separately. Generic badges never imply verified end-to-end access.

principles.name: user_controlled_pacing
principles.requirement: Users can preserve rest, buffers, open time and a no-replacement option; activity count is not treated as a welfare proxy.

principles.name: privacy_minimization
principles.requirement: Prototype planning works without an account or persistent location tracking. No emotional-state inference or persistent sensitive visitor dossier is required.

principles.name: whole_system_constraints
principles.requirement: Known safety, rights, access, legal and ecological hard constraints are not exchangeable for a better commercial or experience score.

principles.name: no_universal_holiday_score
principles.requirement: Report a versioned multidimensional outcome vector; do not collapse holiday quality, joy, happiness, wellbeing or sustainability into a single score.

checks.target: 100% of synthetic offers are explicitly labelled synthetic
checks.verification: fixture audit and automated UI assertions

checks.target: 100% of offers with missing material facts render the named unknown state
checks.verification: negative fixtures for price, access, inventory and schedule fields

checks.target: 100% of simulated confirmation summaries show known total, currency, mandatory fees and key cancellation terms
checks.verification: manual task audit and assertions against the prototype data model

checks.target: zero automatic bookings, silent edits to confirmed plans, fake-urgency prompts or non-dismissable recommendations
checks.verification: interaction audit and adversarial task scripts

checks.target: zero candidates with a known failed hard constraint presented as feasible
checks.verification: decision-contract negative controls

gates.name: digital_accessibility
gates.standard_target: WCAG 2.2 Level AA for all in-scope digital paths

checks.target: zero unresolved critical or serious defects at release gate; lower-severity issues remain in an explicit exception log
checks.verification: automated checks plus manual expert audit

checks.target: zero critical tasks blocked in keyboard-only and screen-reader runs
checks.verification: manual journey testing with representative assistive technology

checks.target: complete the critical journey at 200% zoom, narrow viewport, reduced-motion mode and low-bandwidth condition
checks.verification: documented manual test matrix

gates.claim_limit: This target is not an accessibility certification or legal determination; automated scans alone cannot pass the gate.

gates.name: core_usability
prerequisites: participant consent, recruitment and analysis plan
cohort sample sizes and uncertainty reported

checks.target: at least 90% in the comparative round
checks.verification: task-level observation against preregistered completion rules

checks.target: at least 85% in each adequately sampled priority cohort, with no severe critical-task blocker
checks.verification: stratified reporting with sample sizes and confidence intervals

checks.target: median at least 5.5/7 as an initial hypothesis
checks.verification: post-task ease question and qualitative debrief

checks.target: at least 80/100 as an initial hypothesis
checks.verification: documented System Usability Scale scoring

checks.target: at least 20% relative reduction versus the documented baseline, with task success non-inferior
checks.verification: preregistered effort measure and matched comparative tasks

gates.claim_limit: Targets are hypotheses, not observed results. If the baseline is already better, the new interface must not regress to reach an arbitrary improvement target.

checks.target: 100% of test tasks provide a findable total-cost basis, cancellation conditions and known accessibility gaps before simulated commit
checks.verification: task observation and content audit

checks.target: 100% of recommendations are editable or dismissible and include a user-understandable reason
checks.verification: interaction and explanation audit

checks.target: at least 90% correctly identify unknown offer attributes in controlled comprehension checks
checks.verification: scenario-based comprehension tasks

checks.target: browse, compare, draft and export are possible in the prototype without mandatory account creation
checks.verification: end-to-end smoke test

checks.target: at least 85% of participants complete a preregistered recovery task unaided
checks.verification: observed user test with declared success criteria

checks.target: median at or below 90 seconds in the prototype
checks.verification: timestamped task observation

checks.target: zero unverified substitutions represented as confirmed and zero loss of the original plan in tested scenarios
checks.verification: state-transition assertions and manual audit

checks.target: recovery flow offers rest, skip or end-the-day options when relevant, not only replacement purchases
checks.verification: scenario review and interaction audit

gates.name: whole_trip_validity

checks.target: no claims of improved holiday quality, safety, accessibility, sustainability or restoration until corresponding real-world evidence exists
checks.verification: claim review against study receipts

checks.target: pilot success criteria are defined with participating travellers and local stakeholders before the pilot
checks.verification: dated protocol and stakeholder review record

checks.target: null and adverse findings retained in the study record
checks.verification: protocol-to-report audit

minimum_reported_dimensions: voluntary trip-fit reflection with response-rate and selection-bias caveats
gates.claim_limit: Voluntary self-report is subjective evidence and does not establish objective wellbeing or causality by itself.

study_protocol_requirements: Preregister hypotheses, primary outcomes and non-inferiority rules.
Pin prototype/build identity and synthetic fixture-data version.
Publish task scripts, success/error definitions, stop rules and exclusion criteria.
Document recruitment, cohort, consent, compensation, retention and data minimization.
Document baseline, test order, learning effects and missing-data treatment.
Separate exploratory formative findings from comparative results.
Report cohort sample sizes, uncertainty, serious barriers and adverse findings.
Do not treat a synthetic prototype as evidence of live price correctness, physical accessibility, actual supplier availability or post-trip wellbeing.

research_sources.title: UN Tourism Accessibility Tourism publications and guidelines
research_sources.supports: whole journey accessibility and accessible information
research_sources.does_not_prove: the quality of this proposed interface

research_sources.title: ISO 21902:2021 Accessible tourism for all
research_sources.supports: requirements and recommendations across the tourism supply chain
research_sources.does_not_prove: physical or digital compliance of a particular implementation

research_sources.title: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
research_sources.does_not_prove: good usability or physical destination accessibility

research_sources.title: OECD Tourism Trends and Policies 2026
research_sources.supports: accessible participation, resilience, destination management and broader local benefits
research_sources.does_not_prove: the numeric targets in this contract

evidence_policy.rule: Never convert a target into a PASS merely because it appears in this file. Store evidence receipts and measured outcomes separately, bound to exact prototype/build, fixture, study protocol and report identities.
